mapper.sql: id, out_trade_no AS outTradeNo, user_id AS userId, plan_id AS planId, plan_code_snapshot AS planCodeSnapshot, plan_name_snapshot AS planNameSnapshot, plan_version_snapshot AS planVersionSnapshot, price_vnd_snapshot AS priceVndSnapshot, price_xu_snapshot AS priceXuSnapshot, auto_renew AS autoRenew, primary_funding_source AS primaryFundingSource, fallback_funding_source AS fallbackFundingSource, accepted_plan_version AS acceptedPlanVersion, tickets_per_period_snapshot AS ticketsPerPeriodSnapshot, period_months_snapshot AS periodMonthsSnapshot, ticket_validity_days_snapshot AS ticketValidityDaysSnapshot, pay_channel AS payChannel, client_request_id AS clientRequestId, request_hash AS requestHash, policy_version AS policyVersion, zone_id AS zoneId, status, subscription_id AS subscriptionId, settled_at AS settledAt, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reading_subscription_purchase WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND client_request_id=#{clientRequestId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM reading_subscription_purchase WHERE open_user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM reading_subscription_purchase WHERE out_trade_no=#{outTradeNo} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM reading_subscription_purchase WHERE id=#{purchaseId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM reading_subscription_purchase WHERE id=#{purchaseId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reading_subscription_purchase WHERE status=#{status}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_subscription_purchase (out_trade_no, user_id, plan_id, plan_code_snapshot, plan_name_snapshot, plan_version_snapshot, price_vnd_snapshot, price_xu_snapshot, auto_renew, primary_funding_source, fallback_funding_source, accepted_plan_version, tickets_per_period_snapshot, period_months_snapshot, ticket_validity_days_snapshot, pay_channel, client_request_id, request_hash, policy_version, zone_id, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{outTradeNo}, #{userId}, #{plan.id}, #{plan.planCode}, #{plan.planName}, #{plan.planVersion}, #{plan.priceVnd}, #{plan.priceXu}, #{options.autoRenew}, #{options.primaryFundingSource}, #{options.fallbackFundingSource}, #{options.acceptedPlanVersion}, #{plan.ticketsPerPeriod}, #{plan.periodMonths}, #{plan.ticketValidityDays}, #{payChannel}, #{clientRequestId}, #{requestHash}, #{policyVersion}, #{zoneId}, 'PENDING', #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO reading_subscription_purchase_review_audit (purchase_id, out_trade_no, event_type, from_status, to_status, operator_id, reason, purchase_version_before, purchase_version_after, create_time) VALUES (#{purchase.id}, #{purchase.outTradeNo}, #{eventType}, #{purchase.status}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorId}, #{reason}, #{purchase.version}, #{versionAfter}, #{createdAt})
